scientific_integrity.evidence: Self-contained Gibbs-variational and independent-mark proof in RESULT.md; exact finite-case and seeded transfer-matrix checks in check.py.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Does not establish the same upper bound for general non-rank-one kernels, nor exact spectral radii for every fixed lag law; historical priority is qualified and independent review remains outstanding.
scientific_integrity.scope: Finite states, full-support destination distribution, strictly positive survival factors, arbitrary probability laws on nonnegative ancestral lags.
scientific_integrity.statement: Universal sharp entropy upper envelope, quantitative collision-dependent lower envelope, and exact dispersed-memory limit for strictly positive finite-state rank-one killed kernels.

title: A sharp entropy envelope for rank-one killed chains with arbitrary memory laws
